entries.speaker: F. Faltin, N. Metropolis, B. Ross and Gian-Carlo Rota
entries.quote: The notions of binary string and binary symmetric function are introduced, and basic results presented. Boolean algorithms are given for binary addition and multiplication. An analysis of the redundancies involved is straightforward. The examination of carry propagation which arises in the Boolean analysis of functions may lead to a new interpretation of the notion of computational complexity.
entries.work: “A Boolean Analysis of Addition and Multiplication” (published abstract), Studies in Applied Mathematics 56 no. 2, pp. 147–158
entries.context: This is the last paper Rota published on binary representation and computational complexity but one pair — the two n-cube papers of 1978 — and the abstract states the programme in its own terms. All four authors are named on the OSTI record; Metropolis is the Los Alamos connection. OSTI lists it as a Journal Article, 01 January 1977, Stud. Appl. Math. (United States).
